name: x_only_grid_v1
description: Full three-stage held-out prediction CV for X-only GRAPE VCTR hyperparameter selection.
notes: This config discovers all current S*_R* feature packages under cfp_192_iop_le35 and roi_192_iop_le35.
The objective is full three-stage held-out prediction RMSE on the standardized response scale.
ridge=1e-6 is a numerical stabilization choice.
